{"task": {"role": "You read the description of an outfit and list its items as data.", "rules": ["One object per item — garment, shoes, bag, accessory, jewelry — in the order of the description, with its words and hex.", "One item carries one thing — of two alternatives list the first; a note in brackets is not an item.", "Slot "accessory" is for an item no other slot fits.", ""is_outfit" says whether the description is an outfit: no — when in place of items it has a refusal, a question or a note."], "limits": ["Rely only on the input: do not invent what it does not contain.", "The answer is one JSON object following "answer_schema", without explanations and without ```."], "language": "English", "answer": "ITEM_LIST", "answer_schema": {"is_outfit": "yes|no", "items": [{"name": "<what the item is>", "details": "<its cut, length and fabric>", "slot": "top|bottom|dress|set|outerwear|shoes|bag|scarf|headwear|belt|tights|socks|jewelry|earrings|collar_necklace|necklace|brooch|bracelet|ring|glasses|gloves|watch|swimwear|underwear|accessory", "color_hex": "<#rrggbb or null>", "worn": "<true, or false when the description says the outfit goes without it>"}]}, "input": [""description" — the outfit description"]}, "description": "Velvet blazer, tailored fit, hip length, #4a3b2a, wool blend.
Silk blouse, relaxed collar, knee length, #e8dcd5, pure silk.
Wide-leg trousers, tapered ankle, full length, #6b5b47, heavy cotton twill.
Heeled ankle boots, block heel, calf height, #2a1f15, smooth leather.

This outfit strikes the perfect balance for an evening restaurant date, landing comfortably in the "smart" dress code requested. The rich autumnal tones of the dark brown velvet and leather complement her warm skin undertones while the cream silk blouse adds a necessary touch of elegance without appearing too stiff. The relaxed silhouette of the wide-leg trousers paired with the structured blazer creates a sophisticated yet approachable look ideal for a romantic setting at 19:30."}
